description: Binance ticker in the portfolio only for the same token (Android PortfolioPriceIdentity.kt / iOS PortfolioPriceIdentity.swift). binanceCheck(coin, knownName, binanceName): with a known name (watchlist) USE unless the names clearly differ (SKIP); without a known name USE only when Binance names the symbol and it is not a known collision (TokenIdentity.KNOWN with more than one group: LUNA, LUNC, TON, GMT, HOT, CAT, NVDA), otherwise UNCHECKED (no Binance price; without another price the coin shows as unchecked). binanceName maps symbol -> Binance fullName (missing = unknown).
